function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for founding **ReddyTech Solutions**, a mid‑size IT services firm headquartered in Hyderabad. Born in 1975 in Secunderabad, he earned a B.Tech in Computer Science from Osmania University before working at Infosys for five years. In 2008 he left Infosys to start ReddyTech, which grew rapidly into a regional player offering software development, cloud migration, and cybersecurity services.

Beyond his business ventures, Reddy has been active in community outreach. He established the **Reddy Foundation** in 2012, which focuses on improving digital literacy among rural students in Telangana. The foundation runs coding bootcamps and provides scholarships to under‑privileged children.

He has received several recognitions, including the “Entrepreneur of the Year” award from the Hyderabad Chamber of Commerce in 2015 and was named one of Forbes India’s “30 Under 30” in 2017.
